tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer AHP Office YTPS Raichur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Refurbishment of released parts of Pumps like casings, Impellers and blades etc or fan blades, Wear plates, Heat exchangers, Tanks and vessels, Valves of value not less than 5 Lakhs in the last preceding five financial years in any Thermal plants or Process Industries. As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a work order (single) and corresponding work done certificate issued by the Competent Authority Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2024-25.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work done/ Work order copy

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.10 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last five years (i.e., 2021-2022, 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-2025, 2025-2026). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)
